meta.title: Contivo compared: AI writers, schedulers, ChatGPT and AI agents
meta.description: How Contivo differs from AI writing tools, social schedulers, SEO platforms, ChatGPT-style assistants and AI agents, and where it is still behind. Facts from each vendor's own pages.

compare.headline: Where Contivo is different, and where it <accent>is not</accent>.
compare.intro: Compared with the five kinds of tools a small business would otherwise use for content, by category rather than by brand. Every named example comes from that vendor's own pages, read on {date}.
compare.uniqueTitle: What it does that the others do not

lock.title: It refuses to write first
lock.body: Ideas stay locked until your competitor map and positioning charts exist. None of the tools we compared lists anything like it.

scale.title: It finds your real competitors
scale.body: Companies at your scale, not the famous names in your category, each checked to exist before you see it. Schedulers and SEO tools ask you to name them, or only show who ranks for one keyword.

storyline.title: Every post advances a storyline
storyline.body: Three or four claims your content has to move forward, each with a list of things it must never claim.

gate.title: It vetoes invented facts
gate.body: A judge rejects made-up statistics, studies and client stories, and if no model can review a post, it does not publish. The only similar check we found sits on one writing tool's Enterprise plan.

ownSite.title: It publishes to any website
ownSite.body: Your site reads its posts through one read-only API, whatever it is built on. A developer connects it once.

persian.title: It writes Persian as Persian
persian.body: Not translated from an English draft, and checked against Persian word ranges. Jasper's language list has no Persian.

competitors.assistants: If you ask, every time, unchecked

storyline.assistants: Only if you prompt it each time

factGate.seo: Plagiarism check, not a fact check

autopilot.label: Keeps a schedule full on its own

social.contivo: LinkedIn personal profile only, for now

ownSite.contivo: Any stack, through a read-only API
ownSite.schedulers: WordPress, Webflow, Wix, in one tool

compare.tableNote: Read on each vendor's own pricing and product pages on {date}. “Not listed” means we did not find it on those pages, not that it does not exist. Prices change; check before you decide.
compare.behindIntro: All of this is true today. Some of it is on the way, and none of it is hidden anywhere else on this site.

channels.title: One social network
channels.body: LinkedIn personal profiles only. No company pages, Instagram, Facebook or TikTok. X, Telegram, WordPress and Threads are being built.

languages.title: Two languages
languages.body: Content is written in English or Persian. Writing tools offer thirty or more.

analytics.title: No performance data
analytics.body: It does not yet show how a post performed, and it does not track rankings.

monitoring.title: No competitor alerts yet
monitoring.body: A weekly competitor watch is coming. Some schedulers already benchmark competitors on their higher plans.

estimates.title: Positioning scores are estimates
estimates.body: The model reads public evidence and shows its reasoning. The scores are not measured data.

early.title: Early stage
early.body: Live since August 2026, billing has not started, and there is no customer we can name yet.

price.title: Not the cheapest
price.body: It costs more than a $20 assistant or a $5-a-channel scheduler. You are paying for the research and the refusal, not for the writing.

channels.if: You need Instagram, TikTok or Facebook today
channels.then: A social scheduler such as Buffer or Later already posts there.

languages.if: You publish in a language other than English or Persian
languages.then: An AI writing tool such as Jasper or Anyword covers thirty languages or more.

search.if: You need measured search data and rank tracking
search.then: An SEO platform such as Surfer or Semrush is built for exactly that.

build.if: You like building and running your own pipeline
build.then: An agent stack such as Zapier, n8n or Manus can do much of this loop, as long as you design it and keep it running.

time.if: You have the time to research, write and post yourself
time.then: ChatGPT or Claude at about $20 a month will write good drafts. What they will not do is hold the research, refuse to invent, or post for you.

compare.closeHeadline: If the research matters to you, start there.
